title: Ink Drag
description: A record printed in wet ink on cream letterpress paper: its real album cover, then its title in type. Every few seconds a squeegee sweep drags the cover into the title and the title into the next cover; drag through it yourself and the ink smears along your path, thick and soft when slow, thin streaks when fast.
intent: Type and art as the same matter: one ink field that carries a full-colour cover and its title, pulled from one into the other by the same drag that smears it under your finger.
